newsitem.title: ITALY: Telecom Italia names new Stet MD to board.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Italia names new Stet MD to board.

text.p: Telecom Italia said on Thursday it had co-opted the new managing director of state telecoms group Stet, Tomaso Tommasi di Vignano, as a member of its board.

The move follows Tommasi di Vignano's appointment to replace outgoing managing director Ernesto Pascale at Stet. Pascale resigned from the board of Telecom Italia, the company said in a statement. It said Gaetano Rasi had also left the board,
Telecom Italia is scheduled to be incorporated into Stet and the merged group privatised under the name Telecom Italia.
Tommasi di Vignano's appointment as Stet managing director was announced by the Treasury last week along with the naming of Guido Rossi as Stet chairman in place of Biagio Agnes.
